Target: we'd ideally have this by 2026-08-13 to keep the SIG on track.

Hi Jane — attaching the requested vendor roster and a brief data-flow summary. High level notes below; the attached CSV includes per-vendor service category, region flags, whether customer content (LLM inputs) may be processed, and links to contracts where applicable.

Summary (key vendors):
- Cloud providers: AWS (primary prod: S3, EC2, EKS), GCP (analytics batch jobs, BigQuery), Azure (customer-specific deployments). AWS has EMEA regions we use for EU customers; those rows are flagged in the CSV.
- Telemetry/monitoring: Datadog (metrics/traces), Sentry (error telemetry), Splunk (aggregated logs). We do not send raw LLM request payloads to Sentry; Datadog receives metrics + sampling-level traces and Splunk receives logs that are redacted of full payloads except in rare debug scenarios (not in prod by default).
- Support & comms: Zendesk (support tickets/transcripts when customer initiates), Intercom (in-product messaging for product-initiated flows), PagerDuty (on-call alerts).
- Other: Postgres Cloud (managed DB; encrypted at rest), Redis (cache for ephemeral state; no long-term storage of inputs).

EU transfers: AWS EU regions and Datadog EU are flagged; for any transfers we rely on our DPA + SCCs or equivalent safeguards (contract links included in CSV where available).

Attachments: redwood_vendor_inventory_aug2026.csv (vendor roster), data_flow_diagram_aug2026.svg (simple swimlane showing which vendors see customer content vs telemetry).

Drive link (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link-redwood/vendor-inventory-2026

If you want, we can map these answers back into the SIG spreadsheet itself and mark the corresponding question IDs — happy to do so if that speeds your review.

Regards,
